julia_auditor: Hi team — during our SOC 2 fieldwork we need a few artifacts for the inference stack. Specifically:
1) proof of KMS rotation for the prod key used by the inference runtime (timestamps + key version IDs).
2) RBAC change history for the service accounts that interact with KMS and the inference GPU pool (audit entries showing who changed what).
3) 3-5 sample audit log lines showing a successful decrypt (with request IDs) linked to a known deployment.
Can you confirm what you can hand over and an ETA?

anya: hi julia, we can provide those. i want to scope to the minimum needed — which prod deployment name should we map to the sample logs? prod-inference or prod-llm?

julia_auditor: prod-inference is fine. also we need proof of any emergency key access for the last 12 months, and any RBAC exceptions that were approved (email trail ok).

sam_oncall: ack. i'll pull the Splunk query and a small result set. linking runbook too.

sam_oncall: Splunk query i'll run:
```splunk
index=redwood_audit env=prod component=inference action=kms_decrypt request_id=* | table _time request_id user key_id action status
```

sam_oncall: sample lines (sanitized) below:
"2025-03-11T14:22:01Z request_id=abc123 user=svc-inference key_id=projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/llm-key version=2 action=Decrypt status=OK"
"2025-03-11T14:22:04Z request_id=abc124 user=svc-inference key_id=projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/llm-key version=2 action=Decrypt status=OK"
"2025-04-02T09:05:30Z request_id=def456 user=svc-inference key_id=projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/llm-key version=3 action=Decrypt status=OK"

matt_infra: rotation artifact: we keep key versions and an audit manifest. for llm-key the rotation timeline is: v1 created 2023-08-01, v2 rotated 2024-09-15, v3 rotated 2025-04-01. i can export the key metadata and signed SHA manifest.

matt_infra: emergency access: only ephemeral unwrap keys were used during a 2024 incident; i've got the approval emails and the short-lived access tokens logs.

anya: for RBAC diffs, we have k8s rolebinding change events exported to our audit index. the minimal set the auditor usually wants: rolebinding name, who applied (k8s user/serviceaccount), and the diff payload. i'll attach examples.

julia_auditor: perfect. can you include the runbook steps we followed during the 2025-04-01 rotation (who signed off + rollback playbook)? also please show how we validated no in-flight decryption failures during rotation.

sam_oncall: we validated by tailing the decrypt error rate and verifying prefixes matched expected request_ids. snippet of our monitoring check:```bash
# check last 24h decrypt errors
query="index=redwood_metrics env=prod metric=kms_decrypt_errors | stats sum(value) as total_errors by hour"
```
we ran that between 2025-04-01T00:00:00Z and 2025-04-02T00:00:00Z — zero errors.

evidence-bot: Attached: s3://redwood-evidence/EVID-2026-045/kms-llm-key-rotation-manifest.json (sha256: abcd...1234) and s3://redwood-evidence/EVID-2026-045/rbac-diffs-2024-2025.csv

anya: adding note — RBAC diffs include entries for service account svc-inference and infra-deploy-sa; we redacted other teams.

julia_auditor: thanks. two follow-ups: 1) can you provide the signed KMS key policy and the key wrapping logs showing who performed key version promotions, 2) a short CSV with request_id -> deploy_tag mappings for the 3 sample decrypts so we can tie them to CI deploys?

matt_infra: will export the key policy (signed) and the key promotion audit log (CloudKMS admin API). ETA EOD PST today.

sam_oncall: i'll attach the small CSV with request_id and deploy_tag, plus the splunk raw id so you can replay.

julia_auditor: great — one more ask: any open vulnerabilities that touched the inference runtime in the last 90 days and the triage/corrective actions? we need the tracker IDs and remediation dates.

anya: we have VULN-2025-331 (cuda driver CVE) - patched in staging 2025-02-10, rolled to prod 2025-02-18. mitigation notes and PR link in the evidence bundle.

julia_auditor: thanks team, that should be everything for now. i'll review the artifacts and DM if any gaps. :thumbsup:
